decisions.reason: After four years this accessory's demand should be well understood, and because it is inexpensive to carry and complements the core trailer business, it is still worth keeping.
The specialized car transporter line uses more resources and, with several years of market experience by now, the firm would likely redeploy capacity if the line has not proven strong enough.
Low-bed trailers are close to the firm's core offering, so a series that has remained relevant for several years is more likely to justify continued support than withdrawal.
As a complementary cover range that supports trailer sales and is relatively cheap to maintain, it remains attractive to keep in the portfolio.
With the other box trailer series already removed, this line likely became the firm's main box-trailer option and is worth retaining unless recent sales have clearly disappointed.
